text:
incident-bot: [AUTO-PAGE] Prometheus scrape healthcheck alert firing: target_scrape_failures > 5 in prod-exporter group (us-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-south-1). PagerDuty escalation level 1.

pagerbot: PD alert #P23456 auto-created and routed to Sam (oncall). Escalations: Sam -> Maya -> Jorge.

Sam (oncall): ACK. I'm on it. First check prometheus targets and kube status.

Maya: I'm checking grafana now — lots of missing series for frontend.request_latency and ingress.* in us-west. Confirming whether exporters are flapping.

Sam (oncall): `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=prometheus-exporter -o wide`

Sam (oncall): got OOMKilled on exporter-2 in us-west-1, restarts count 3 in last 5m. logs:

Maya: ```
2026-03-15T02:14:02Z exporter[42]: runtime: out of memory
panic: runtime: out of memory
... stack trace ...
``` 

Jorge: Looks like memory pressure from log-agent burst after spike in logs. Ingest queue length shot up. Running `kubectl scale deployment log-agent --replicas=5 -n logging` to add capacity.

Sam (oncall): Scaling done. Also bumping exporter mem limit temporarily to 1Gi: `kubectl patch deploy prometheus-exporter -n monitoring --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"prometheus-exporter","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"1Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"512Mi"}}}]}}}}'`

Maya: Confirmed prometheus targets now 98% up after restart of exporter pods. Some metrics backfilled, but frontend.request_latency still missing from eu-central.

Jorge: In eu-central exporter pods are healthy but exporter logs show 429s from scraping upstream app. Could be app-side rate limiting. Temporarily enabling scrape relabel and lowering scrape frequency for that job to 15s -> 60s to reduce load.

Sam (oncall): Applied relabel to prometheus config; reloaded config. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus -n monitoring`

Asha (Customer Success): Heads up — support page for customers receiving anomalous latency graphs. Any customer-facing impact? Should we send an advisory?

Maya: Some dashboards showed gaps for a subset of customers for ~8m. No ingestion loss of persisted logs, this is scrape visibility. Recommend a short advisory: "We observed partial metrics visibility in some regions; graphs may show gaps; we're investigating; no customer data loss expected."

Sam (oncall): I'm escalating to Maya for handoff. @Maya you're 2nd oncall; please take lead. I'll stay available for followups.

Maya: Taking over. I'll coordinate with Jorge to follow root cause. Paging will be suppressed for this alert group for 20m while we stabilize.

pagerbot: PD #P23456 acknowledged by Sam (oncall). Escalated to Maya. Auto-suppression window set: 20m.

Customer Success: Drafting advisory now, will coordinate with legal for tone. ETA 10m.

Maya: Tracking items: 1) Confirm exporter mem fix persists 2) Verify no further 429s from app 3) Backfill/mark dashboards 4) Postmortem if recurrence. If anyone sees new failures ping here.

Sam (oncall): Closing initial page. Good job team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for alert group prometheus-scrape-failures. If condition recurs will re-open and page next oncall in rotation.
